motivation: Same-island subcolonies are often censused on identical dates, so apparent within-island annual coherence could reflect shared census timing rather than a demographic island effect. This audit conditions exactly on the start- and end-census dates used to form each annual growth observation.

data_and_residualization.eligibility: Identical to PALMER_ISLAND_YEAR_COHERENCE_V1: island-specific colony_code with >=3 informative adjacent-year transitions; zero-to-zero transitions excluded; no imputation or code merging.

timing_match.pair_year_inclusion: Include a colony-pair × end-year record only if both colonies were censused on exactly the same calendar date in the start year and exactly the same calendar date in the end year.
timing_match.rationale: Within a schedule block, any timing-induced phenology bias from the two census dates is shared by within-island and between-island pairs.

statistic.response: Product of the two regional-residualized standardized colony-growth values for the matched pair-year.
statistic.coefficient: Within-schedule fixed-effect coefficient for same_island, computed by demeaning response and the same_island indicator within each schedule block.

null.labels: Static colony island labels are permuted within the same five deterministic transition-count/abundance rank strata frozen in PALMER_ISLAND_YEAR_COHERENCE_V1.
null.inference: two-sided permutation p; support also requires positive observed same_island coefficient

analyses.strong_timing_robustness: Both primary and four-island sensitivity have positive coefficient and two-sided p <= 0.05.

interpretation_boundaries: A positive result means exact shared census dates are insufficient to explain the island-coherence signal.
This does not rule out other island-specific observation processes such as observer identity or unrecorded within-day protocols.
A negative result requires downgrading the demographic interpretation of island coherence.
This remains a post-result audit and does not convert earlier exploratory analyses into preregistered evidence.
Do not alter date matching, schedule block definition, residualization, permutation strata, permutation count, or decision rule after opening the result.
